The original app saved player data but not enough information to resume a round. These original values are preserved as a read-only recovery scorecard.

1. Add at least two players in seating order. Tap Start game, choose the deal order, then choose and confirm the dealer. Custom trumps is the default. Scoring and other settings are optional. Saved players can be selected from the player list.

2. Each game has rounds. In a round, deal the shown number of cards to each player. Deal 5 cards each means 5 hands can be won in total. Predict how many hands you will win. The player after the dealer predicts first; the dealer predicts last. Total predictions must differ from the hands available. The latest prediction can change until the next player predicts.

3. After the round, mark Won if the hands a player won matched their prediction, otherwise Lost. Predicting 0 and winning 0 is Won. Lost always scores 0. Impossible results show a reason beside the round.

Default: Won earns 10 + predicted hands, including zero. Predict 0 and win 0 → 10 points. Predict 3 and win 3 → 13 points.

Aggressive: Won with zero hands earns 7. Any other Won earns 10 + predicted hands. A matched prediction above half the hands in the round adds a majority bonus equal to the round’s hand count, capped at 10. Exactly half earns no bonus. The total score is not capped.

Custom: choose Create custom from the scoring dropdown, name your strategy, then set the zero-hand reward, base reward, points per predicted hand, and optional majority bonus. Saved strategies remain available next time. Modify edits their rules; Delete removes them from the saved list. Existing games and completed rounds keep their rules.

Change scoring strategy from the three-dot menu. Before predictions, changes apply to the current round. After predictions begin, changes apply from the next round. Completed rounds keep their recorded rules.

The dealer advances after each round. Cyclic trumps rotate through Spades, Diamonds, Clubs and Hearts. With Custom trumps, choose trump at the table. Player or dealer changes after predictions begin require a confirmed round restart. Added players start at zero; removed players keep their scores and can be restored. With fewer cards available, descending games step down immediately; ascending games finish if their current deal exceeds the new maximum. Leaving the app preserves the game; Resume from Home.

History: open a completed round to inspect or edit its predictions and Won/Lost results. Preview points before saving. The original scoring rules apply. Current-round progress and separate score corrections are preserved.

Final results: the table colors match the cumulative-score graph. Absent rounds leave gaps. If anyone missed rounds, the table also shows rounds played and points per round. Tap a round on the graph to inspect it. Play again reuses players and settings with Custom trumps selected. Choose deal order and dealer again. Starting the new game replaces the current scores only after confirmation.
